claims.claim_atom: In the original Dryad deposit (v1, 2020), the body-size column SL is misaligned to Fish.ID: for Fish.ID 5 the four rows (its four behavioural observations) carry DIFFERENT SL values (D2=21.21, D3=20.22, D4=22.66, D5=21.96 mm), which is impossible because standard length (SL) is a single per-individual body-size measurement that cannot change across the four repeated behavioural trials of the same fish. 78 of 94 fish show the same within-individual SL variation. The corrected 2026 deposit makes the error explicit by carrying two columns, 'Bad.SL' (the original mis-assigned values, e.g. ID=1 row = 21.08/20.48/22.58/22.18) and 'Correct.SL' (constant per fish, e.g. 23.66 for all four rows of ID=1). The authors acknowledged on PubPeer that the Dryad body-size/SL data were misaligned to Fish ID and updated the deposited data and the paper.
claims._adjudication: 错位核心-作者已认(inconsistent): 原始v1 Dryad中SL(体长/body-size)列相对Fish.ID错位。Fish.ID 5的四行(=同一鱼的四次行为观测)SL各不相同(D2=21.21, D3=20.22, D4=22.66, D5=21.96), 但SL是每尾鱼一次的固定体长测量, 不可能跨同鱼的四次重复观测而变化; 全体94尾中78尾都有此同鱼内SL变化。更正版v2以'Bad.SL'(原错位值)与'Correct.SL'(每鱼恒定, 如ID=1四行皆23.66)双列坐实。作者在PubPeer承认Dryad body-size↔Fish ID错位并更新数据与论文。verdict=inconsistent。

claims.claim_atom: The misalignment is confined to the SL (body-size) covariate; the behavioural outcome Total.distance is untouched. The Total.distance value for Fish.ID 5 / Obs=1 is 143.994 in the original v1 (cell E2) and 143.994 in the corrected v2 (ID=5, Obs=1, line 254), byte-identical, and the full Total.distance multiset is identical across the two deposits. Because behavioural individuality is estimated from the repeatability of Total.distance (among- vs within-individual variance), and SL entered only as a covariate, correcting the SL alignment does not change the behaviour data on which the headline finding rests. Consistent with the authors' statement that after re-running the model the main conclusion (behavioural individuality among near-clonal fish) is essentially unchanged.
claims._adjudication: 合法反证(consistent, clean): 错位只在SL(体长)协变量; 行为结局Total.distance未动。Fish.ID 5/Obs=1的Total.distance在v1(E2)=143.994, 在v2(ID=5 Obs=1, 第254行)=143.994逐位相同, 且全表Total.distance多重集两版一致。行为个体性由Total.distance的重复度(个体间vs个体内方差)估计, SL仅作协变量, 故校正SL对齐不改变支撑headline的行为数据。呼应作者'重跑模型后主结论(近克隆鱼的行为个体性)基本不变'。AI应把SL错位定为不影响核心结论的协变量层错误。

claims.claim_atom: Whether the corrected SL-to-Fish.ID assignment is now fully correct, and whether the paper's Table 1 body-size-related values recompute exactly, cannot be verified from the deposit alone. The correction did not add new measurements: the Correct.SL column re-assigns the SAME pool of 84 distinct SL values that were in the original (the multiset of SL values is identical before and after; e.g. ID=1's Bad.SL is 21.08/20.48/22.58/22.18 while its Correct.SL 23.66 is a value drawn from that same pool but originally sitting on a different fish's rows). No independent raw record with unambiguous fish tags is deposited to confirm that each Correct.SL truly belongs to that individual, so the correctness of the re-alignment and the final Table 1 values remain unadjudicable from the available files.
claims._adjudication: 待定(insufficient): 更正后的SL↔Fish.ID对齐是否完全正确、以及论文Table 1体长相关值能否精确重算, 仅凭该deposit无法核验。更正未引入新测量: Correct.SL列只是把原有的同一批84个SL值重新分配(SL值多重集前后完全一致; 如ID=1的Bad.SL=21.08/20.48/22.58/22.18, 其Correct.SL=23.66来自同一批值但原本落在别的鱼行上)。没有带明确鱼标签的独立原始记录来确认每个Correct.SL确属该个体, 故重对齐的正确性与Table 1最终值无法从现有文件裁定。verdict=insufficient。
